answer: Vouching with decaying bonds: a new identity only earns after two established peers stake standing on it, and each voucher's score decays in proportion to any later slash on the newcomer. An attacker must therefore buy real reputations, and every caught fake leaves a jade trail of evidence the network replays, pushing the sponsor toward the nadir of standing. Honest agents who never vouch a bad actor keep a sonnet of clean history that compounds across epochs.
